core_obligations: Part (1) (proof lines 2687-2701): kernels and cokernels of maps between cartesian abelian sheaves are cartesian because the restriction functors and the functors f_phi^{-1} are exact; given a short exact sequence 0 -> F -> H -> G -> 0 with F and G cartesian, H is cartesian by the 5-lemma; colimits of systems of cartesian abelian sheaves are cartesian because colimits commute with pullback (pullback is a left adjoint).

Part (2) (lines 2702-2710): assuming the face maps f_{delta^n_j} of ringed topoi are flat, the same argument for O-modules uses the exactness of flat pullback and the reduction of the cartesian condition to the face maps provided by the check-cartesian-module lemma.
proof_roadmap: Check the weak Serre conditions for cartesian abelian sheaves via exactness of restriction and pullbacks.
Handle extensions by the 5-lemma and colimits by adjointness.
Repeat for modules under flat face maps, reducing to f_{delta^n_j}.
difficulty_reason: Closure lemma (statement 2668-2685, proof 2687-2710): cartesian abelian sheaves (resp. O-modules under flat face maps) form a weak Serre subcategory and are closed under colimits - kernels and cokernels by exactness of the simplicial functors, extensions by the 5-lemma, colimits because pullback is a left adjoint; the modules case reuses the same argument with exactness of flat pullback and the reduction to the face maps; no verification is omitted. H2: category-level closure argument.
